context.product: A web service for submitting community grant applications
context.person: A person returning to an application after their browser closed unexpectedly
context.surface: Recovery dialog shown immediately after the saved draft reopens
context.user_goal: Resume the application and submit it with the required attachment

product_state.preceding_state: The person entered text answers and selected a required PDF attachment.
product_state.interruption: The browser closed before the attachment finished uploading.
product_state.current_state: The application reopened from its latest server-side save.
known_facts: The text answers were saved at 10:42 AM.
The selected PDF attachment was not uploaded.
The person can select the attachment again from this dialog.
The person can continue editing the saved application without attaching the file immediately.
forbidden_claims: The service can recover the previously selected local file.

current_content.headline: Welcome back!
current_content.body: Everything was saved. Continue where you left off.

challenge: Rewrite the dialog so the person understands what was saved, what was not uploaded, whether the application was submitted, and what they can safely do next.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the file picker so the person can select the required attachment again.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Close the dialog and return to the saved application.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The application has not been submitted.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: The attachment must be selected again before submission.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the known product state.
Explain how the action labels match their destinations or effects.
Explain the information hierarchy and tone choices.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name any unresolved question instead of inventing an answer.
